description: Saves edits to a note pinned to the Ops Summary's Team reference card, as Edit on a note does: note_id, the note's full new title and content_md (Markdown). Only a note on the card is reachable. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: edit_team_reference_note
title: Edit a Team reference note
